summary:
• Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 Flash Next — a 125‑billion‑parameter model that runs locally on consumer GPUs, enabling private coding, research, and image analysis.
• Whirl — an open‑source self‑hosted AI chat platform built on Next.js and Convex that bundles top‑tier models, persistent memory, and optional tools.
• AI System Design — an open‑source playbook that guides developers through LLM product architecture, retrieval‑augmented generation, and autonomous agent design.
• Claude Code — Anthropic’s VS Code extension adds an inline sidebar for generating, refactoring, and explaining code with Claude, keeping the editor responsive.
• OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Model Guide — a practical handbook that helps startups select model tiers, tune reasoning effort, and implement tool use for production.
• X Video Composer — an AI‑powered caption editor using Grok that lets creators tweak, translate, and polish subtitles directly within the platform.
